## App framework

Examples: Next.js, Express, Node.js worker, serverless function, background job, or other.

## Provider or library

Examples: OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, custom provider, or multiple providers.

## What are you trying to track?

Examples: provider, model, input tokens, output tokens, user ID, customer ID, feature name, or estimated cost.

## Current code shape

Paste a small sanitized example of where your AI call happens. Do not include API keys, tokens, customer data, or private URLs.

## Expected result

Describe what you want the usage event to show in AIProfitHub.

## Problem

Describe what is unclear or broken.
